_comment: This file is a pure configuration file (no functions, classes, or callable APIs). It defines dataset settings, data preprocessing pipelines, and dataloader configs for ImageNet with MobileNet-V3 in MMPretrain.
use_cases: Configure ImageNet dataset with batch size 128 for MobileNet-V3 pretraining
Define train/test data augmentation pipelines (AutoAugment, RandomErasing, RandomResizedCrop)
Set up data preprocessing normalization parameters (mean/std for RGB/BGR)
Configure train/val/test dataloaders with worker settings and samplers
Set up validation/test evaluators for top-1 and top-5 accuracy
reason: This file contains only variable assignments (dictionaries and lists) used as configuration for MMEngine/MMPretrain. There are no functions, classes, or importable callable code.
